identity: A black-green attrition deck whose engine runs counters in both directions at once. Yawgmoth, Thran Physician reads 'Pay 1 life, Sacrifice another creature: Put a -1/-1 counter on up to one target creature and draw a card' - every spare body becomes removal AND a card - and '{B}{B}, Discard a card: Proliferate', which gives 'each another counter of each kind already there'. A single proliferate therefore deepens the -1/-1 counters killing the opponent's creatures and simultaneously grows the +1/+1 counters on Spiritmonger, Phyrexian Scuta, Kavu Primarch and Forgotten Ancient. Two things the grill made me state plainly. First, the +1/+1 half is a GROWTH engine, not a kill: Triskelion converts counters to damage one at a time, which is reach and removal, not a clock - the actual kill is combat damage from bodies that proliferate has enlarged. Second, both halves of the engine have a per-activation cost, so the deck is built to pay them: proliferate costs a card, which Dark Withering's Madness {B} turns into a one-mana kill spell, and the sacrifice costs a body, which Squirrel Nest and Oversold Cemetery renew instead of merely spending.

restrictions.deck_level_cap: max 5 rare+mythic total across mainboard + sideboard

sideboard.name: Tormod's Crypt
sideboard.oracle_text: {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Exile target player's graveyard.
sideboard.when_to_board: Against the cube's 45 graveyard-interaction cards - the largest answerable class. Board in knowing it fights this deck's own Chainer's Edict / Call of the Herd flashbacks and Oversold Cemetery.

sideboard.name: Break Asunder
sideboard.oracle_text:
Destroy target artifact or enchantment.
Cycling {2} ({2}, Discard this card: Draw a card.)
sideboard.when_to_board: Against the cube's 24 artifacts + 33 enchantments. It is 1 of only 5 artifact answers and 1 of only 4 enchantment answers in the entire cube, and the only one in B/G.

sideboard.name: Ichor Slick
sideboard.oracle_text:
Target creature gets -3/-3 until end of turn.
Cycling {2} ({2}, Discard this card: Draw a card.)
Madness {3}{B} (If you discard this card, discard it into exile. When you do, cast it for its madness cost or put it into your graveyard.)
sideboard.role: Flex: removal for Terror's blind spot
sideboard.when_to_board: Against black or artifact creatures, which Terror cannot target - 36 of the pool's 120 unique creatures (30%). Its Madness cost is also live off Yawgmoth's proliferate discard.

sideboard.name: Giant Spider
sideboard.oracle_text: Reach (This creature can block creatures with flying.)
sideboard.when_to_board: Against the cube's 42 evasion cards; 37 of those 42 are flying-based, so Reach covers 88% of the class.

sideboard.name: Duress
sideboard.oracle_text: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a noncreature, nonland card from it. That player discards that card.
sideboard.when_to_board: Against control and combo. B/G has zero counterspells in this pool, so stripping the card beforehand is the only answer to the 4 sweepers and to noncreature bombs.

identity_es: Un mazo negro-verde de desgaste cuyo motor mueve contadores en ambas direcciones a la vez. Yawgmoth, Thran Physician dice 'Pay 1 life, Sacrifice another creature: Put a -1/-1 counter on up to one target creature and draw a card' — cada cuerpo sobrante se vuelve eliminación Y carta — y '{B}{B}, Discard a card: Proliferate', que da 'each another counter of each kind already there'. Un solo proliferar profundiza por tanto los contadores -1/-1 que matan a las criaturas del rival y a la vez hace crecer los contadores +1/+1 de Spiritmonger, Phyrexian Scuta, Kavu Primarch y Forgotten Ancient. Dos cosas que conviene decir con claridad. Primera: la mitad de +1/+1 es un motor de CRECIMIENTO, no una victoria: Triskelion convierte contadores en daño de uno en uno, lo que es alcance y eliminación, no un reloj; la victoria real es el daño de combate de cuerpos que proliferar ha agrandado. Segunda: ambas mitades del motor tienen un coste por activación, así que el mazo está construido para pagarlos: proliferar cuesta una carta, que el Madness {B} de Dark Withering convierte en un hechizo de matar de un maná, y el sacrificio cuesta un cuerpo, que Squirrel Nest y Oversold Cemetery renuevan en lugar de solo gastar.
